***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****[[2026 Israel–Lebanon peace talks]]
*****[[Hezbollah]] [[Secretary-General of Hezbollah|secretary-general]] [[Naim Qassem]] says that he "categorically rejects" negotiations between [[Israel]] and [[Lebanon]], and that "[[Axis of Resistance|the resistance]]" will continue. **[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****The [[Associated Press]] and ''[[Axios (website)|Axios]]'' report that [[Iran]] has offered to reopen the [[Strait of Hormuz]] if the [[United States]] lifts [[2026 United States naval blockade of Iran|its blockade]] and if the war ends. [https://apnews.com/live/iran-war-israel-trump-04-27-2026 (AP)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/27/trump-iran-war-strait-of-hormuz-rubio.html (CNBC)] [https://www.axios.com/2026/04/27/iran-us-hormuz-strait-nuclear-talks-proposal-pakistan (Axios)]
****[[United States Secretary of State|U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Marco Rubio]] states that Iran's position on access to the strait does not meet U.S. requirements, while [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] discusses a reported Iranian proposal on reopening the route with his [[United States National Security Council|national security advisers]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/us-will-not-tolerate-iranian-control-or-tolls-in-strait-hormuz-rubio-6085011 (AFP via CNA)]
***[[Nuclear program of Iran]]
****Iran and the U.S. dispute at a review conference of the [[Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons]] at the [[United Nations]], amid disagreement over Iran's election as a vice president of the meeting and its compliance with treaty obligations. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-un-nuclear-nonproliferation-treaty-us-2dee996cbaec872604baabc4cbd3f4df (AP)]
*[[Mali War]]

[https://www.reuters.com/world/al-qaeda-linked-group-says-mali-army-withdraws-town-north-2026-04-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Piracy off the coast of Somalia]]
***[[Somalis|Somali]] [[Piracy|pirates]] storm and hijack a [[Saint Kitts and Nevis]]-flagged [[cargo ship]] off the coast of [[Puntland]] that was en route to [[Kenya]]. [[Puntland Maritime Police Force|Puntland maritime police]] say nine gunmen boarded the vessel and are currently in control of the vessel and are heading towards [[Mogadishu]]. The status of the crew is not known. [https://apnews.com/article/somalia-puntland-pirates-cement-vessel-hijack-cargo-ab118acd23935582a53a72a994e31bfa (AP)]

**Fourteen people are killed and 84 others are injured after an [[Argo Bromo Anggrek]] train collides with a [[KRL Commuterline]] train near [[Bekasi Timur railway station|Bekasi Timur Station]] in [[West Java]], [[Indonesia]], prompting evacuations. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/train-collision-indonesia-jakarta-bekasi-casualties-6084381 (AFP via CNA)]
